mapper.select: SELECT po.payment_obligation_id AS paymentObligationId, po.participant_id AS participantId, sp.user_id AS userId, u.name AS participantName, po.expected_amount AS expectedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0) AS paidAmount, MAX(pr.recorded_at) AS latestPaymentAt, GREATEST( po.expected_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0), 0 ) AS remainingAmount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0) = 0 THEN 'UNPAID' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0) < po.expected_amount THEN 'PARTIALLY_PAID' ELSE 'PAID' END AS paymentStatus, po.obligation_status AS obligationStatus, po.overdue_since AS overdueSince FROM payment_obligation po JOIN settlement_participant sp ON sp.participant_id = po.participant_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN payment_record pr ON pr.payment_target_type = 'SETTLEMENT' AND pr.target_id = po.payment_obligation_id AND pr.record_status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE sp.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND sp.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' AND po.obligation_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'WRITTEN_OFF') GROUP BY po.payment_obligation_id, po.participant_id, sp.user_id, u.name, po.expected_amount, po.obligation_status, po.overdue_since ORDER BY po.payment_obligation_id

SELECT po.payment_obligation_id AS paymentObligationId, po.obligation_status AS obligationStatus, po.expected_amount AS expectedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0) AS paidAmount FROM payment_obligation po JOIN settlement_participant sp ON sp.participant_id = po.participant_id LEFT JOIN payment_record pr ON pr.payment_target_type = 'SETTLEMENT' AND pr.target_id = po.payment_obligation_id AND pr.record_status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE sp.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND sp.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY po.payment_obligation_id, po.obligation_status, po.expected_amount
